name: Page header
use: the top of every page and of every top page of a task: Back at the top left, the title beside it, an optional header line, then 24px to the body
notUse: a drawer or a dialog (use the sheet header); it never holds a control besides Back and the subject chip, a count, a status or an aside
states: Longest title that fits beside Back at 360

name: Sheet header
use: the top of every drawer: the title centred, an optional header line (a hub only), Clear or Reset at the top right while there is something to clear or reset, a ✕ at the top left in a drawer with levels (it closes the whole drawer; the footer Back goes up a level), then the hairline and 24px to the body
notUse: a page (use the page header); an action launched from a hub never carries a line (the hub is one Back away); nothing else acts in it: no counts, no status, no Save
states: Longest title that fits between the corners at 360
